scope: All 31 shared pages; complete PDF-native text on 22 pages plus selected source checks on scans and structures
reference_status: Retrospective assistant source review plus PDF-native text; not independent human labels or held-out benchmark
reference_exclusions: Faint rotated annotations on diary selected page 1; no trustworthy complete transcription
Diary page 5 ambiguous names, signature, right-page entries and most cursive text
Moon tables and calendar digits have detection checks but no full cell-level reference
Math exclusions remain those in frozen assignment reference
limitations: IRENA/IMF lack outputs from all four profiles and are excluded from ranking.
Printed token F1 measures content overlap including repetitions, not semantic correctness, layout or reading order.
WER uses native PDF sequence; differences include source text-layer order and omitted raster-only text.
Missing, timed-out and unparseable generations contribute empty text and failed checks; no completed-page-only accuracy.
Raw content of schema-invalid pages is scored separately from strict canonical pipeline yield.
Scanned pages have selected assertions, not complete CER/WER references.
Visual checks measure localization recall at IoU 0.5 with 0.25 sensitivity; partial region annotations cannot establish precision or semantic description quality.
Only three bar category/value pairs are available; no general chart-model ranking.
Assignment scores reuse unchanged selected reference/evaluator; no model answers repaired.
Different hardware, image preprocessing, runtime backends and conversion lineage prevent causal quantization and speedup claims.
Original Q4 comparison uses the upstream-prompt job matching BF16 sent PNGs, rather than the later project-prompt rerun.
